caption: The drawing depicts a fragmented sculpture or relief of a human figure, specifically showing the upper torso, head, and one arm raised above the head. The object appears weathered, with visible cracks and worn surfaces. The colors used include gray, beige, pale yellow, and muted browns for the skin and hair, suggesting the texture of aged and chipped stone or painted wood. There are accents of turquoise and yellow-green on the arm, which resemble the remnants of decorative elements such as a bracelet. The face is detailed, with features including a nose, mouth, and eyes visible, framed by long, textured hair. The bottom portion of the torso is incomplete, with the edges roughly broken or eroded. The background is plain and a light beige, allowing the figure’s details to stand out against it.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: Dancing Girl
